dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Hello there.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: I could hear you coming from miles away.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Hmm, this place has a peaceful environment and a wonderful view. Very pleasant.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: ...Perhaps a little too pleasant.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Look, I've already mapped out an itinerary of my stay.

choices.text: You're planning on doing some forest-watching here?

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Haha, that would be going too far. This place was constructed by magic, right? I don't sense any dangers.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: And I'm guessing that the only ones who can get in here are those you have specifically invited.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: If they're your friends, I'm sure they won't cause any major disturbances.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: ...Right? They wouldn't, would they?

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Erm... half and half.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: I'm just wandering around here and there, observing various flora as I always do.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: This is equal parts research and normal life.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: But I should probably take a more relaxed approach while I'm here. I'll only plan 60% of my typical itinerary.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Should you need me, come find me any time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Want to chat?

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Of course. Anything you want to talk about?

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: If you let me start the conversation, it would definitely be about plants.

choices.text: It's fine. I was expecting that, anyway.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Oh? So you're ready for class?

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Then let us begin with the basics. Botany is a branch of biology that focuses on the morphology, taxonomy, ecology, genetics, and evolution of plants.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: The basic taxonomical classification of plants is as follows:

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: No daydreaming, sleepyhead! This is what you asked for.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: ...Heh, alright, I'm only teasing. People who don't work in this field don't have to bash their heads against the books.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: However, you spend a considerable amount of time traveling and traipsing through the outdoors. It would behoove you to learn a thing or two about common plants.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: For instance, discerning a plant's growth patterns to orient position, how to use stems and leaves to acquire potable water...

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Which fruits are edible and palatable, which herbs are suitable for cooking with meat...

choices.text: Oh no, I'm starting to drool...

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Hey, what's the matter with you!? Is this what happens when you hear anything remotely about food?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It's mostly Paimon's fault...

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Ah yes, your little partner...

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: She doesn't seem the most... intellectual sort, but she cares deeply about you.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Even if it's only for the sake of protecting your companion, you should learn more about the natural sciences.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Ah... Sorry, I slipped into training mode there for a second, look at me, talking to you like you're a rookie Forest Ranger. ...Please forgive me.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Anyway, you're smart enough to understand what I meant.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: If you ever wish to learn more about flora, my door is open any time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Me? Just thinking about some recent tasks that need to be completed.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: This week, I have to observe some experiments and record their results at Pardis Dhyai. It's also about time to draw up the next patrol schedule for the rangers...

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Nothing especially urgent, though, so this can all wait.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: So? Anything in particular you want to do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hmm... Nope.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Oh? So then, why did you ask?

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Alright, I'll go ahead. Please answer one question for me.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Yes or no: Do you want to rub my ears?

choices.text: Wha... You're turning this back to me!?

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Don't blame me, I gave you the opportunity to go first.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Actually, uh... I don't really mind if someone I'm close to rubs my ears, you know?

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: I'm not sure why, but everyone always seems to think that it would make me angry.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Over time, "Do not discuss ears or tails in Tighnari's presence" became something of an unspoken rule.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: It can sometimes be quite amusing to watch people's faces as they stumble over their words.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: It's probably for the best, anyway. It might get irritating if people I barely knew started coming up to me and getting all touchy-feely.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So you're saying that I can...?

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Of course.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: They might not feel as nice as you're imagining, though. They honestly just feel like anything you'd find on a regular cat or dog.

choices.text: Well, I'll be the judge of that.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: I give you an inch, so you take a mile?

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: ... *sigh* Okay, fine.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: As long as you're happy.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: I'd be willing to take hundreds of group photos with you, so a pat or three is nothing.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Your gaze seems to have been wandering slowly earwards the whole time we've been talking.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Tighnari.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Morning. The day's plans are best made at dawn. The early bird catches the worm.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Early-rising worms might object to this, of course, but that's just how the food chain works.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: See, no matter how early they rise, a tree's leaves will still get eaten by insects. You don't hear them complaining, do you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good evening, Tighnari.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: #You aren't asleep yet, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: If you're still awake at this hour, then how about I borrow you as my research assistant?

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: This cabin looks very familiar indeed. I see you've been treating our excursions as an opportunity to admire the scenery in quite some detail...

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Just being here makes me want to start planning my schedule... Force of habit, I suppose.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Well, there's plenty of space — would you like to sit with me and try your hand at writing something yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Very diverse range of plants you have here. Clearly, you have a keen interest in botany.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Excellent. If nurtured, a budding interest can become a fruitful source of knowledge. In fact — why don't you tell me about each of these species? Their growth habits, preferences, et cetera?

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I'm here to fill in anything you leave out. I have a feeling it'll stick in your memory this time.
